title: 第5章 开始修仙第6章 人参我要了
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
这是什么意思？如果他没记错的话，金银花应该是种下的第二年才能开花。
看到这个，林鹤清又用盖子取了一滴灵液，往里面倒了一点水，然后把这个混合的液体倒一半给金银花，退后两步，等待。
果然金银花又开始变化，花朵变绿、变白、变黄又来了一遍，而且结的果实也掉落了，但是林鹤清还是一直看着它。
金银花不久又开了花，这次它开了花以后，花朵一直挂在枝头，黄灿灿的，十分好看。
“我知道了，一滴灵液获得的能量可以供植物三年的营养，而且还能加快植物生长，稀释以后，也有作用，只是稀释的越多，作用越小。”
林鹤清惊喜道，“那我可以用来种贵重的药材，就可以得到年份大的药材了。”
“不不不，我要保持之前的生活，如果突然拿出这些东西，别被人烧死了。”
林鹤清一阵后怕，他差点被这惊喜冲昏头脑了。
不能把这里的东西随便拿出去卖，“那这里的东西能不能给人喝呢？人也一下子长的好高，瞬间长大？”他的思维又发散起来。
不过，他不会为了长大做这种事的，小孩子的身体做很多事情都很有利，别人也会下意识对小孩不防备。
林鹤清把碗里的灵液装进玉瓶里，把碗又放回池子里，等着灵液收集起来。
林鹤清回到茅草屋，把人参拿起来翻了个面，其实人参没怎么湿，就是包着它的锦盒有一点淋湿了。
今天林鹤清要做的最重要的事，就是他要开始修仙了。
如果不去修仙，就是坐拥宝山而不自知，这里面最有价值的东西，就是这个玉简。
毕竟授人以鱼不如授人以渔，自己学会了法术，总比空间里留下一堆什么金银财宝，什么神丹妙药要好的多，最起码这个力量得到了之后是你的，别人抢不走的。
林鹤清坐在那个蒲团上，静坐五分钟，冷静了之后，他拿起玉简，闭上眼睛，把玉简靠在自己额头上。
脑海里出现了一本很厚的书，书是盖上的，上面写着“凌天决”三个大字，它上面的文字不是他见过的任何一种文字。
但是在林鹤清看到它的瞬间，却能知道上面写着“凌天诀”，这可能就是信上说的，必须要能感受到灵气的人才能修仙吧。
等了一会，这本书没有丝毫动静，“要怎么把这本书打开呢？我在这里又看不到自己的手。”林鹤清正考虑要怎么把书打开的时候，书打开了。
林鹤清凑前去看，一开始上面没有字，知道林鹤清的所有心思都集中在书中的时候，有字出现了，上面写着“引气入体”。

下面是口诀：“心如止水，万念皆空。深吸一气，三呼而吐；短吸一气，长呼而出。循环往复，心无他物。
深吸一气，内视其中，经终游走，随气而动，循环周天，一周而出。
周天完成后，即已引气入体。”
这段口诀之后还有一段小字：“凌天诀任何灵根资质均可修行，与天赋无关，吾欲凌驾驭于天之上，苍天能奈我何”。
这段文字看的林鹤清热血沸腾，同时他的担忧也烟消云散，是的，他一直担心自己的资质不佳。
在蓝星看小说的时候，老是能看见什么天灵根，五灵根什么的，资质不同，命运可谓是天上地下。
林鹤清怕自己的灵根不好，或者与这个玉简上的不符合，白白浪费了机会。
content_en:
What does this mean? If he remembered correctly, the honeysuckle should not bloom until the second year after it was planted.
Seeing this, Lin Heqing took another drop of spiritual liquid with the lid, poured a little water into it, then poured half of the mixed liquid to Honeysuckle, took two steps back, and waited.
Sure enough, the honeysuckle began to change again. The flowers turned green, white, and yellow again, and the fruits also fell off, but Lin Heqing still looked at it.
The honeysuckle bloomed again soon. After it bloomed this time, the flowers kept hanging on the branches, yellow and beautiful.
"I understand. The energy obtained from a drop of spiritual liquid can provide nutrients for plants for three years, and it can also speed up plant growth. It also has an effect after dilution, but the more it is diluted, the smaller the effect."
Lin Heqing said in surprise, "Then I can use it to grow valuable medicinal materials, and I can get old medicinal materials."
"No, no, no, I want to keep my old life. If I suddenly take out these things, I won't get burned to death."
Lin Heqing was frightened for a while, he was almost carried away by the surprise.
You can't just take out the things here and sell them. "Can the things here be used by people to drink? People can grow so tall all of a sudden and grow up in an instant?" His thoughts started to diverge again.
However, he won't do such a thing just to grow up. Children's bodies are very beneficial to many things, and others will subconsciously be unprepared for children.
Lin Heqing put the spiritual liquid in the bowl into the jade bottle, put the bowl back into the pool, and waited for the spiritual liquid to be collected.
Lin Heqing returned to the thatched house, picked up the ginseng and turned it over. In fact, the ginseng was not very wet, but the brocade box in which it was wrapped was a little wet.
The most important thing Lin Heqing has to do today is to start cultivating immortality.
If you don't cultivate immortality, you are sitting on a treasure mountain without knowing it. The most valuable thing here is this jade slip.
After all, it is better to teach a man to fish than to teach him to fish. It is better to learn the magic by yourself than to leave a bunch of gold and silver treasures or magical elixirs in the space. At least once you get this power, it will be yours and no one else can take it away.
Lin Heqing sat on the futon and sat quietly for five minutes. After calming down, he picked up the jade slip, closed his eyes, and placed the jade slip against his forehead.
A thick book appeared in his mind. The book was covered with three characters "Ling Tian Jue" written on it. The words on it were not any kind of words he had ever seen.
But the moment Lin Heqing saw it, he could tell that it said "Lingtian Jue". This may be what the letter said, that only those who can feel spiritual energy can cultivate immortality.
After waiting for a while, the book did not move at all. "How do I open this book? I can't see my hands here." When Lin Heqing was thinking about how to open the book, the book opened.
Lin Heqing came forward to take a look. There were no words on it at first. When he knew that all Lin Heqing's thoughts were focused on the book, words appeared, which said "Introducing Qi into the body".
Here is the mantra: "The heart is like still water, and all thoughts are empty. Take a deep breath, exhale three times, and exhale; inhale a short breath, and exhale a long breath. The cycle goes on and on, and there is nothing else in the mind.
Take a deep breath and look inside. The end of the meridian will wander, move with the breath, circulate around the sky, and come out one week.
After the Zhou Tian is completed, the Qi has been introduced into the body. "
After this mantra, there is a small text: "Ling Tian Jue can be practiced by anyone with spiritual roots and qualifications. It has nothing to do with talent. I want to dominate the sky, and what can the sky do to me?"
Lin Heqing's blood boiled after reading this paragraph, and at the same time his worries disappeared. Yes, he had been worried about his poor qualifications.
When reading novels in Blue Star, I can always see some kind of heavenly spiritual roots, five spiritual roots, etc. With different qualifications, the destiny can be said to be in the sky and on the earth.
Lin Heqing was afraid that his spiritual roots were not good or did not match what was written on this jade slip, thus wasting the opportunity.
